skill.name: libtv-skill
skill.description: Use LibTV to create, edit, poll, upload, and download AI-generated images and videos through the Liblib.tv agent-im API.
skill.summary: Create and manage LibTV image and video generation workflows from an AI assistant.
skill.author: libtv-labs

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally contacts LibTV services, reads a bearer access key, uploads user-selected media, polls sessions, and writes downloaded results locally. Most static command, reconnaissance, and entropy findings are false positives from Markdown examples or LibTV project identifiers. The main risks are credential-bearing network calls, configurable API hosts, user-controlled command arguments, and local file writes.

remediation.issue: Credential-bearing requests can be sent to a configurable API host.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict OPENAPI_IM_BASE and IM_BASE_URL to approved LibTV domains, or require a clear warning before sending LIBTV_ACCESS_KEY to any custom host.

remediation.issue: Local media uploads send user files to an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before uploading local files and document that files are transferred to LibTV OSS.

remediation.issue: Command examples include user descriptions and file paths.
remediation.suggestion: Invoke scripts with argument arrays and never build shell strings from untrusted user text or paths.

remediation.issue: Downloaded media is written to user-selected local directories.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize output paths, warn before writing outside the default downloads folder, and avoid overwriting existing files.

content.value_statement: Creative teams need fast image and video generation without manual job tracking. This skill sends prompts to LibTV, polls progress, uploads references, and downloads results.
actual_capabilities: Creates new LibTV agent-im sessions for image and video generation requests.
Sends follow-up messages to existing LibTV sessions by session ID.
Uploads user-selected image or video reference files to LibTV OSS.
Polls session messages to find generated image and video result URLs.
Downloads generated media from LibTV result URLs into local folders.
Switches the LibTV project bound to the configured access key.
limitations: Requires LIBTV_ACCESS_KEY and network access to LibTV services.
Uploads local reference media to LibTV, so sensitive files need approval.
Only supports image and video uploads under 200 MB.
Generation quality and timing depend on LibTV backend models and queues.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate image concepts, short videos, or product visuals from a brief and collect the finished files locally.

use_cases.title: Edit Reference Media
use_cases.description: Upload an existing image or video, request object changes or style transfer, and retrieve the edited result.

use_cases.title: Track Long Generation Jobs
use_cases.description: Poll LibTV sessions for progress, continue a conversation, and share final result links when the job completes.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one generated image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a calm product hero image for a white ceramic mug on a clean desk. Save the result when it finishes.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Short Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-second vertical video of a city bicycle moving through light rain at night. Use a cinematic but realistic style.

prompt_templates.title: Edit Uploaded Media
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a local reference file for an edit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload this reference video and change the paper boats into white paper hearts. Keep the original camera movement and lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Plan and Retrieve a Storyboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with polling and downloads.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a nine-panel 16:9 storyboard for the next scene of this story. Poll until complete and download all generated panels.

output_examples.input: Generate a poster image for a new tea drink with a fresh green theme.
output_examples.output: The skill starts a LibTV session, waits for the generated image URL, downloads the poster, and returns the local file path plus the project link.

output_examples.input: Edit this product video so the background becomes a clean studio set.
output_examples.output: The skill uploads the selected video, sends the edit request to LibTV, polls for completion, and provides the edited video result.

output_examples.input: Continue the current session with another landscape variation.
output_examples.output: The skill sends a follow-up message to the existing session and reports new image or video results when available.

best_practices: Confirm before uploading private or client-owned media to LibTV.
Keep session IDs and project IDs with the project notes for later polling.
Use clear creative goals and let the LibTV backend handle prompt expansion.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential source files without explicit user approval.
Do not rewrite the user prompt into a complex prompt unless asked.
Do not expose project canvas links before the generation task completes.

faq.question: What credentials does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs LIBTV_ACCESS_KEY in the environment to authenticate with LibTV APIs.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image or video?
faq.answer: Yes. It uploads the reference file first, then sends the edit request to LibTV.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: Downloaded results are saved to the requested output folder or the default LibTV downloads folder.

faq.question: Does it support non-media uploads?
faq.answer: No. The upload script only accepts image and video MIME types.

faq.question: Can it continue an existing session?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the session ID and it can send a follow-up message to that session.

faq.question: Which AI assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
